maddeler.e:
اصطبحت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَحْتُ (iṣṭabaḥtu) /isˤ.tˤa.baħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اِصْطَبَحْتَ (iṣṭabaḥta) /isˤ.tˤa.baħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اِصْطَبَحْتِ (iṣṭabaḥti) /isˤ.tˤa.baħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# اِصْطَبَحَتْ (iṣṭabaḥat) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.ħat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
